column1: # The message read of a value outside its declared range (docs/SPEC-TABLES.md
# §3.3): the writer (writer.schema, the record at another build: no range, a
# plain float, a wider bits field) saves each value, and the reader
# (reader.schema) loads it after the writer's announcement.
# TestRustMessageOutOfRangeRefusedByName reads every row, holds the Go oracle
# (tablewire.DecodeMessages) to the verdict and the generated Rust reader to
# verdict: read (the value is held, ticks is the first field read) or
# out_of_range (refused by name, not as wire damage; nothing is read).
